_comment: Maps a Rust concept marker to the chapter it's first legal in. Only genuine concept introductions belong here (things the book actually teaches as new, chapter by chapter) — NOT baseline syntax primitives (let, mut, fn, loop, i32, &, String, ...) that are legal from chapter 1 onward once introduced and would otherwise false-positive on every later exercise. scripts/check-vocabulary.mjs fails an exercise whose solution uses a marker whose chapter is greater than the exercise's own chapter.
